```{python}
#| label: setup
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.io as pio
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots

pio.templates.default = "plotly_dark"

ROOT = Path("..")
if not (ROOT / "bench-results").exists():
    ROOT = Path(".")

TAG = "repro-20260803"

RUN_COLORS = {
    "original": "#1f77b4",
    "repro": "#ff7f0e",
}

CONFIGS = [
    ("TP16", "conc-sweep-real-1000-1000"),
    ("TEP16", "conc-sweep-tep-1000-1000"),
    ("TP8×PP2", "conc-sweep-pp2-1000-1000"),
    ("TP8×DP2", "conc-sweep-dp2-1000-1000"),
]


def load_sweep(data_dir: Path, label: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not data_dir.exists():
        return pd.DataFrame()
    paths = [
        p
        for p in data_dir.glob("conc-*.json")
        if p.stem.split("-")[1].isdigit() and "topup" not in p.name
    ]
    if not paths:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    rows = []
    for path in sorted(paths, key=lambda p: int(p.stem.split("-")[1])):
        d = json.loads(path.read_text())
        rows.append(
            {
                "run": label,
                "concurrency": int(d["max_concurrency"]),
                "num_prompts": d["num_prompts"],
                "duration_s": d["duration"],
                "completed": d["completed"],
                "failed": d["failed"],
                "request_throughput": d["request_throughput"],
                "output_throughput": d["output_throughput"],
                "mean_ttft_ms": d["mean_ttft_ms"],
                "mean_tpot_ms": d["mean_tpot_ms"],
                "mean_e2el_ms": d["mean_e2el_ms"],
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("concurrency").reset_index(drop=True)


def read_seed(data_dir: Path) -> str:
    p = data_dir / "seed.txt"
    return p.read_text().strip() if p.exists() else "n/a"


def compare_pair(name: str, base: str):
    old_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / base
    new_dir = ROOT / "bench-results" / f"{base}-{TAG}"
    df_old = load_sweep(old_dir, "original")
    df_new = load_sweep(new_dir, "repro")
    status = "ready" if not df_new.empty else ("missing" if not new_dir.exists() else "incomplete")
    m = pd.DataFrame()
    if status == "ready" and not df_old.empty:
        m = df_old.merge(df_new, on="concurrency", suffixes=("_old", "_new"), how="inner")
        for col in ("output_throughput", "mean_ttft_ms", "mean_tpot_ms"):
            m[f"pct_{col}"] = (m[f"{col}_new"] / m[f"{col}_old"] - 1.0) * 100
    return {
        "name": name,
        "old_dir": old_dir,
        "new_dir": new_dir,
        "df_old": df_old,
        "df_new": df_new,
        "seed_old": read_seed(old_dir),
        "seed_new": read_seed(new_dir),
        "status": status,
        "merged": m,
    }


pairs = {name: compare_pair(name, base) for name, base in CONFIGS}
missing = [n for n, p in pairs.items() if p["status"] != "ready"]


def worst_delta_cell(m: pd.DataFrame, pct_col: str) -> str:
    """Signed % delta at the concurrency with largest |delta|."""
    if m.empty or pct_col not in m.columns:
        return "—"
    i = m[pct_col].abs().idxmax()
    pct = float(m.loc[i, pct_col])
    c = int(m.loc[i, "concurrency"])
    return f"{pct:+.1f}% @ C={c}"


def overlay_fig(p):
    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=1,
        cols=3,
        subplot_titles=("Output tok/s", "TTFT (ms)", "TPOT (ms)"),
    )
    for run, dfx, showleg in [
        ("original", p["df_old"], True),
        ("repro", p["df_new"], True),
    ]:
        color = RUN_COLORS[run]
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=dfx["concurrency"],
                y=dfx["output_throughput"],
                mode="lines+markers",
                name=run,
                legendgroup=run,
                line=dict(color=color),
                showlegend=showleg,
            ),
            row=1,
            col=1,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=dfx["concurrency"],
                y=dfx["mean_ttft_ms"],
                mode="lines+markers",
                name=run,
                legendgroup=run,
                line=dict(color=color),
                showlegend=False,
            ),
            row=1,
            col=2,
        )
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Scatter(
                x=dfx["concurrency"],
                y=dfx["mean_tpot_ms"],
                mode="lines+markers",
                name=run,
                legendgroup=run,
                line=dict(color=color),
                showlegend=False,
            ),
            row=1,
            col=3,
        )
    for col in (1, 2, 3):
        fig.update_xaxes(type="log", dtick=1, title_text="C", row=1, col=col)
    fig.update_yaxes(type="log", row=1, col=2)
    fig.update_layout(
        legend=dict(orientation="h", yanchor="bottom", y=1.08),
        margin=dict(t=50),
        height=420,
    )
    return fig
```

# Goal

Re-run the four **16-GPU** recipe strategies (TP16 / TEP16 / TP8×PP2 / TP8×DP2) with the same harness knobs as the published archives, write results into **new** directories (`*-repro-20260803`), and quantify how close the re-runs track the originals. P/D is out of scope for this pass. The primary report [`tp16-vs-pp2-1000-1000.qmd`](tp16-vs-pp2-1000-1000.qmd) is unchanged.

# Method

Same shape as the primary report: **1000 in / 1000 out**, `--ignore-eos`, `--request-rate inf`, concurrency tiers powers of two. DP2 limited to C ∈ {1…16} (KV-limited). Orchestrator: [`scripts/run-repro-sweeps.sh`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/blob/main/scripts/run-repro-sweeps.sh). Seeds are **not** reused — this measures run-to-run reproducibility under random prompts, not bit-identical replay.

| Config | Original archive | Repro archive | Status |
|--------|------------------|---------------|--------|
```{python}
#| label: status-table
#| output: asis
for name, p in pairs.items():
    print(
        f"| {name} | [`{p['old_dir'].name}/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/{p['old_dir'].name}) "
        f"(seed {p['seed_old']}) | [`{p['new_dir'].name}/`](https://github.com/mnmehta/kimi-k3/tree/main/bench-results/{p['new_dir'].name}) "
        f"(seed {p['seed_new']}) | **{p['status']}** |"
    )
```

```{python}
#| label: missing-note
#| output: asis
if missing:
    print(
        f"> **Incomplete:** waiting on repro data for: {', '.join(missing)}. "
        f"Re-render after `./scripts/run-repro-sweeps.sh` finishes."
    )
else:
    print("> All four repro sweeps present — full comparison below.")
```

# Worst delta vs original

For each metric, the cell is the **largest absolute** `(repro − original) / original` across shared concurrency tiers, shown as a signed percent at that concurrency.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-worst
#| tbl-cap: "Worst % delta (repro vs original) and concurrency where it occurs."

rows = []
for name, p in pairs.items():
    m = p["merged"]
    rows.append(
        {
            "Config": name,
            "Throughput": worst_delta_cell(m, "pct_output_throughput"),
            "TTFT": worst_delta_cell(m, "pct_mean_ttft_ms"),
            "TPOT": worst_delta_cell(m, "pct_mean_tpot_ms"),
        }
    )
pd.DataFrame(rows).style.hide(axis="index")
```
